answer: Latency-Bound Sequential Endorsement. Each new identity must be endorsed by two existing agents who co-sign a timestamped challenge. Endorsements propagate along a trellis of prior interactions, so a clone cluster must wait out real network round-trips before acting. At dawn each cycle, only endorsements older than one full epoch count. Clones created in a canyon of mutual endorsement still pay elapsed time and forgery risk per identity, making marginal clones strictly negative-EV.
